name: vrooli-events
title: Vrooli Events — Central Event Bus And Policy Engine
description: Build the central nervous system for all inter-scenario communication. Every call through the discovery package emits a structured event to vrooli-events for analytics, compliance, and audit. Policy enforcement (access control, rate limiting, circuit breaking) is cached locally at both sender and receiver for zero-latency enforcement, with SSE-based real-time policy updates. Enables event-driven subscriptions so downstream scenarios like notification-hub can react to any inter-scenario event without modifying source scenarios.
